answer: Unrepeatable challenge grafting. Each identity must submit a freshly grown vine cutting whose node pattern encodes the requester's live challenge value read off a public mirror feed; the graft is accepted only if no prior submission shares that pattern. A valid entry also requires a sonnet keyed to the cutting's growth sequence, so the answer cannot be copied or reused. Attackers must grow and verify a new cutting per identity, paying real greenhouse time and labor; replay fails immediately.
